reuse.why: Builds the schedule with recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule and applies weekend rules through the shared skipsWeekendOccurrences and getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers, mirroring getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The skip-daily-weekends vs move-to-Friday/Monday dispatch is written a third time (after getNextDate and getUpcomingDates) instead of being factored into one occurrence-to-final-day function.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered like it; the pure date computation could arguably live in shared/schedules with the other weekend helpers.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Short and readable, with the scan-window margin explained, but a future change to weekend handling must be repeated in three dispatch sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing shared weekend helpers rather than its own weekend arithmetic.

disguised_duplication.where: The weekend dispatch in getDatesInRange (schedules/app.ts) repeats getUpcomingDates' skip-vs-move choice in a chained filter/map form; it is a recognisable repetition of the same small idiom rather than a disguised copy.
